Today in @EnergyCommerce #SubOversight, I questioned experts on the #MentalHealth crisis.

Mental health—just like physical injury—is a major component of wellness & must be treated as such.

I’m proud to advance @BAMHTF's 2021 Legislative Agenda to expand access to support. https://t.co/ueSffRRex9

SNAP has saved thousands of families from slipping into poverty. But—as I highlighted in @HouseAgDems today—we have a lot of work ahead to make nutrition assistance more accessible.

I'm working with @USDA to ensure we streamline SNAP & lift families across the country. https://t.co/bB9nIMw2Ot

No Granite Stater should have to worry about where their next meal will come from—I’m working on @HouseAgDems to bolster nutrition assistance in the next Farm Bill & ensure every family in New Hampshire has the healthy, nutritious food they need to thrive.
https://t.co/E3UPvzAIpN

Today in @HouseAgDems, I urged my colleagues to join me in strengthening nutrition assistance programs & expanding the nutrition safety net.

I'm working to lower costs for Granite Staters & ensure no family has to choose between putting food on the table or other essentials. https://t.co/xu6V53bsOp

This bill keeps the gov't open, extends funding for job training programs, nutrition assistance, & affordable housing, & supports our veterans. The legislation averts a gov't shutdown in the short term, but more work remains. I'll continue pushing for increased funding for NH.

Everyone should have access to safe, clean drinking water.

After years of advocacy, I’m pleased to see these new standards to protect our water supplies here in New Hampshire and across the country from dangerous PFAS chemicals.
https://t.co/D8NoZe2NjC
Mental health is a critical component of wellness, and it is essential that we treat it that way.

Nutrition assistance programs play a critical role in ensuring New Hampshire families have access to healthy, nutritious food – but 30% of eligible families aren’t signed up for benefits.

Check to see if you and your family qualify for assistance here 🔽
https://t.co/Dz1F26SOZv

I’m honored to be named a #Champion4Children by @Campaign4Kids.

From affordable health care and housing to quality education and nutrition, I’ll keep fighting to ensure kids across New Hampshire have access to the resources and support they need to thrive! https://t.co/SR5HB1iIPJ

Today is New Hampshire's First-in-the-Nation Primary!

It’s important to exercise your right to vote and have your voice heard!

Make a plan to vote and find your polling location ⬇️ https://t.co/7OHfI12UI3

Thank you for your letter, Christine!

We must treat mental health like the critical component of wellness that it is. I was proud to fight to ensure Medicare can cover mental health services in NH and beyond.

Learn more➡️https://t.co/639SE5QQ4V
https://t.co/6Jpxf9AAS5

Time is of the essence for children and adults with rare diseases who need access to specialized treatments and life-saving therapies. 

Today in @EnergyCommerce, I urged my colleagues to support measures that reduce barriers to care for patients with medically complex needs. https://t.co/4F8u70fwl4

When politicians insert themselves into personal, private medical decisions, patients & families pay the price.

The realities facing pregnant women in LA are horrifying—we must restore the protections of #Roe & ensure no one is denied the care they need.
https://t.co/6LRShtxw49

Seniors & folks enrolled in Medicare Advantage deserve to know which doctors are in their network & accepting new patients.

Proud to help introduce the REAL Health Providers Act to simplify our health care landscape & protect seniors from unexpected costs.https://t.co/qwGCpYx4Ji

For Americans trying to quit smoking, smoking cessation therapies can be a game changer. But, no new treatment has been approved in 20 years.

I led my colleagues in sending a letter to HHS urging innovation to improve the availability of these treatments.
https://t.co/fDvPzAs8au

Cyberattacks on our health care systems disrupt access to care & threaten the data of millions of patients.

Today in @EnergyCommerce, with AHA National Advisor for Cybersecurity and Risk John Riggi, I highlighted the importance of securing the data of patients in NH & beyond. https://t.co/mvguj8ZHZA

For those diagnosed with cancer and other diseases, early detection and treatment can make all the difference.

I’ll keep working to improve Medicare and expand access to breakthrough advancements like multi-cancer early detection tests.
https://t.co/9BU2zkpMCX

Expanding access to treatment & recovery services is key to ending the substance use disorder crisis.

I’m urging my @EnergyCommerce colleagues to support legislation to reform the Medicaid Inmate Exclusion policy & help justice-involved individuals access the support they need. https://t.co/RzKsuWa28b

Substance use disorder has impacted every community across NH—every life lost to addiction & overdose is a tragedy.

This increase in SOR funding will help turn the tide on this epidemic, expand access to treatment & recovery services, & help save lives.
https://t.co/jPLht7N98j

At a time when overdose deaths are falling, we must make it easier for people to get the help they need, not harder.

Today, I urged my @EnergyCommerce colleagues to support legislation making remote prescribing for medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder permanent. https://t.co/SABy94lRJO

Every life lost to substance use disorder is a tragedy.

Tackling this crisis calls for an all-of-the-above approach—we must continue to expand access to treatment and recovery services and make it easier for people to seek the help they need and deserve.
https://t.co/bWNjtU8xVk

The FDA plays a vital role in developing new medications, but this is only beneficial if patients can access & afford them.

Today in @EnergyCommerce, I urged my colleagues to support my legislation to encourage competition & ensure approvals are not delayed due to patent gaming. https://t.co/3ULmDG11A9

Ensuring opioid overdose reversal medications are accessible is critical to tackling the opioid epidemic.

I'm encouraged to see declining numbers of overdoses across NH, but I recognize more work remains to expand access to treatment & recovery services.
https://t.co/Q0RI1KmxMV

Mifepristone is safe & effective—we’ve known this for  20 years.

Personal & private medical decisions about birth control should be made between patients & their doctors. Pleased to see SCOTUS reject this extreme attempt to restrict access to reproductive health care & abortion.

Evidence shows a strong link between animal abuse and domestic violence, child abuse, and elder abuse. 

Proud to introduce bipartisan legislation to provide a better foundation for abuse screening, prevention, and treatment programs and data collection.
https://t.co/6a6pZRFknz
